eyebrow.zh: 病历不出院 · 可审查时间线 · 逐步审计
eyebrow.en: PHI stays on-prem · Reviewable timeline · Audit-stamped

headline.zh: 把传真病历变成可审查的临床时间线
headline.en: Turn faxed records into a reviewable clinical timeline

sub.zh: 在一台机器上入库传真与扫描病历,解析成编码临床事件,组装去重时间线 —— 病历不出本机,每一步都带审计戳。
sub.en: Ingest faxed and scanned records on one host, resolve them into coded clinical events, and assemble a de-duplicated timeline — PHI never leaves, every step audit-stamped.

body.zh: 传真与扫描的病历在一台机器上就地处理,零云调用 —— 不再让病历出站,承担 HIPAA 违规风险。
body.en: Fax and scanned records are processed on a single host with zero cloud calls — no more HIPAA breach from records leaving the site.

body.zh: 重复传真、自由文本就诊、残缺结构化字段 —— 全部解析成病情、用药、操作、日期、机构的编码临床事件,而不是一堆互不相干的文本片段。
body.en: Repeat faxes, free-text encounters, partial structured fields — all resolved into coded clinical events for conditions, meds, procedures, dates, and providers, not disjoint text fragments.

body.zh: 同一份就诊的重复传真被识别并合并,汇成一条按日期排列、带证据片段的临床时间线 —— 而不是同一事件出现三次。
body.en: Repeat faxes of the same encounter are recognized and merged into one dated, evidence-linked timeline — not the same event three times.

body.zh: 每一次抽取都记一条审计记录,每条记录与前一条密码学链接 —— 审查方仅凭本机产物就能复现整条链,任何篡改都会在断链处暴露。导出审计日志,直接交给合规。
body.en: Every extraction step is recorded as an audit entry, each cryptographically linked to its predecessor — a regulator can replay the chain from local artifacts alone, and any tampering breaks the chain. Export the audit log straight to compliance.

body.zh: 内置质量检查在去标识样本上报告精确率与召回率,对比基线 —— 达不到这条线,这个原语就不该存在。不是黑盒。
body.en: A built-in quality check reports precision and recall on a de-identified sample against a baseline — miss the bar and the primitive shouldn't exist. Not a black box.

headline.zh: 把传真病历变成可审查的时间线
headline.en: Turn faxed records into a reviewable timeline

sub.zh: 开源原语免费;ClinRec Pro 提供本地化部署托管与监管级审计包。
sub.en: The OSS primitive is free; ClinRec Pro adds managed on-prem deployment and a regulator-grade audit pack.
